propositions: FAIL remediation guidance omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence admissibility, causing operators to attempt ticket-comment-only retries that cannot succeed per ADR 0043.

Untagged external criteria are deliberately classified as codebase-verifiable by ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md, so the remediation guidance must state this distinction and the tag requirement explicitly.

The generic remediation text must preserve the no-force posture and not change completion-verdict semantics while distinguishing repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence.
The remediation interface test must be strengthened to require the exact tag prerequisite and assert that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone.
